memory_update.text: KRT is the cleanest underfollowed public mapping for restaurant delivery/takeout packaging: small-cap, direct disposable foodservice product exposure, chain/distributor channel growth, eco-friendly packaging angle, and logistics/custom printing capabilities.
GPK should be retained as a reference benchmark for scaled foodservice/QSR paperboard packaging, but not over-weighted in underfollowed discovery because it is broader and more followed than KRT.

PACK is a speculative shadow candidate: cold-chain and paper-based protective packaging are relevant to last-mile food logistics, but disclosed food/beverage end-user sales were only about 3% of FY2025 net revenue.

AVY may be a hidden data/labeling layer for restaurants through QSR traceability, BOH labeling, freshness, temperature monitoring, and inventory workflows; financial materiality must be verified before it survives later funnel layers.

Several obvious foodservice packaging assets are private or delisted by 2026, including Pactiv Evergreen/Novolex and Sealed Air/CD&R; the public-market universe may be narrower than the actual operating chokepoint universe.

node: Delivery packaging, cold-chain consumables, and last-mile operating supplies
summary: Expanded the US-listed universe for restaurant delivery packaging and last-mile consumables with a two-lane funnel. Reference context is Graphic Packaging, a scaled foodservice/QSR paperboard packaging supplier. The underfollowed lane is led by Karat Packaging, a small-cap disposable foodservice packaging distributor/manufacturer with direct restaurant-chain and distributor exposure. Ranpak and Avery Dennison are included as lower-confidence adjacent chokepoint hypotheses: Ranpak for sustainable paper/cold-chain protective packaging with currently small food/beverage exposure, and Avery Dennison for restaurant/QSR traceability, labeling, and possible tamper-evident operating supplies. Pactiv Evergreen and Sealed Air were not included as active candidates because evidence indicates both became private or acquisition-closed by 2026.
